Am expecting to raise the PR sometime today with some more tests This is great! Happy to review it when you have it. In a post BAL world, since the EIP changes account access gas semantics (essentially making it a two level check for code vs nocode), the EIP document could use some more clarity on when an account is marked as accessed in the BAL. For example, say a call tries to access an account which has code. The call has enough gas to pay `COLD_ACCOUNT_COST_NOCODE=500` but not enough to pay `COLD_ACCOUNT_COST_CODE = 2600`. The account still needs to be included in the BAL as accessed, since we have to load the account first to find out if it has code. This wouldn't have mattered as much in a pre-BAL world

excerpts.content:
In a post BAL world, since the EIP changes account access gas semantics (essentially making it a two level check for code vs nocode), the EIP document could use some more clarity on when an account is marked as accessed in the BAL.

For example, say a call tries to access an account which has code. The call has enough gas to pay `COLD_ACCOUNT_COST_NOCODE=500` but not enough to pay `COLD_ACCOUNT_COST_CODE = 2600`. The account still needs to be included in the BAL as accessed, since we have to load the account first to find out if it has code.
